verdict.rationale: Entra's own diagnostic settings let admins route activity logs to other endpoints for long-term retention, which gives some control over log retention. Nothing documents configuring retention periods or deleting data. Missing for 10: documented retention-period controls, data deletion/purge capabilities, coverage of data beyond activity logs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Using Microsoft Entra diagnostic settings, you can route activity logs to several endpoints for long term retention and data insights.
